answer: Harness attestation has each agent submit a probe: a ferrous hardware digest, a plume of timing features, and an onyx salt on the output hash. Peers cluster probes; only distinct clusters count toward quorum. Each identity bonds, pays per attempt, clears a five-peer quorum, and is rate-capped for days before trust. A ring fails because one operator's timing and hardware invariants correlate across puppets, collapsing them into one cluster; forged diversity still demands separate bonds, fees, and waiting time.
